changes.title: Beach pixels
items: The beach's sand is pixelated like everything else now, chunky and grainy instead of smooth

changes.title: Fennec
items: A new creature for the hot south: the fennec fox, a small sand fox that's mostly ears, and its own area, the Erg: dunes, date palms round an oasis and a ring of sandstone round an old hearth
The fennec's legend, asleep under the sand, gives Fennec's Ears: 💌s reach further

changes.title: Ring roster
items: Each island's outer woods now grow the same kinds of trees as the areas next to them, so every island has its own forest right to the shore
Landing on an island is quicker: fewer kinds of tree to draw
